editing.branch-versioning.summary: Core branch versioning (Pro): named gdb versions, isolated edits, reconcile/post, and gdbVersion-scoped editing/querying. Organisational approval and policy controls remain Enterprise. Preview in 2026.1; the experimental runtime opt-in remains required.
editing.branch-versioning.statusNote: Preview in 2026.1; the experimental runtime opt-in remains required. No GA promotion.

ai.approval-workflows.summary: Enterprise organisational approval workflows and policy-scoped agent permissions. Essential authorization, isolation, and audit integrity remain baseline product obligations.

dr.backup-automation.summary: Enterprise scheduling and orchestration of PostgreSQL base backups and WAL archiving. Essential backup, restore, and recoverability remain baseline obligations in every edition.

dr.failover.summary: Enterprise automated active-passive failover playbooks driven by health checks. Essential recovery procedures remain baseline obligations in every edition.

dr.cache-backup.summary: Enterprise automation for Redis warm-cache recovery during regional failover. Recovery of enabled durable Redis job/workflow state remains a baseline obligation in every edition.

dr.rto-rpo-reporting.summary: Enterprise automated RTO/RPO reporting and recovery-readiness dashboards. Documented recovery expectations and verified restores remain baseline obligations in every edition.

admin.control-plane.summary: General administrative CRUD surfaces (connections, metadata, services, users, roles, configuration) with no dedicated entitlement of their own. Tenant administration is Preview/trial only in 2026.1; GA is single-tenant, with no hosted service or production multi-tenant deployment. Cross-tenant isolation remains mandatory.

serve.i3s-scene.summary: Serve I3S metadata previews through Enterprise-gated SceneServer handlers; unlicensed requests return HTTP 402.
serve.i3s-scene.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.

serve.3d-tiles-scene.summary: Serve published 3D Tiles scene layers through the SceneServer surface. Scene ingest (CityGML/point cloud) is Enterprise-gated separately.
serve.3d-tiles-scene.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.

serve.elevation.summary: Query elevation profile and point-value surfaces. Sun/shadow, slice, line-of-sight, and viewshed analytics are Pro-gated separately.
serve.elevation.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.

scene.catalog.summary: Discover published 3D scene layers through the scene catalog surface.
scene.catalog.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.

scene.bim-ingest.summary: Ingest CityGML building models into a servable Building Scene Layer 3D Tiles tileset with per-feature discipline / sub-layer semantics.
scene.bim-ingest.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.

scene.pointcloud-ingest.summary: Ingest LAS point clouds into a servable 3D Tiles point tileset preserving per-point classification, intensity, and RGB.
scene.pointcloud-ingest.statusNote: Experimental in 2026.1. Edition entitlement does not imply production support or a GA commitment.
